business_one_liner: Plant tissue culture biofactory for biofungicide (ABM-01) and vaccine adjuvant (QS-21) from Quillaja saponaria.

business_one_liner: Bacterial biofortificants (CRIOPROTECT frost protection, NANOFORTE soil biotech) from Antarctic and Atacama extremophiles.
description: Develops biofortificant products leveraging Antarctic and Atacama extremophile microorganisms. CRIOPROTECT: frost protection via Pseudomonas pewmanensis (naturally isolated in Antarctica). NANOFORTE: soil enhancement with microbial consortia + oxygen nanobubbles. Funded by CORFO, ANID, FIA (public sources totaling $1M+). Winner of Mercurio 2024 Startup of the Year. Unique geographic IP advantage.
